    <dc:title>Dearly Beloathed 2: The Exquisite Torment of Loving Your Enemy</dc:title>
    <meta name="calibre:title_sort" content="Dearly Beloathed 2: The Exquisite Torment of Loving Your Enemy"/>
    <dc:creator opf:file-as="Knightley, Brigitte" opf:role="aut">Brigitte Knightley</dc:creator>
    <dc:contributor opf:role="bkp">calibre (9.13.0) [https://calibre-ebook.com]</dc:contributor>
    <dc:description><b>The stakes are high, the love is forbidden, and the slow burn turns steamy in this swoony, witty, and heart-stoppingly romantic sequel to instant <i>New York Times</i> bestseller <i>The Irresistible Urge to Fall For Your Enemy</i>.</b><br>Osric is a member of the Fyren Order, a guild of assassins who gleefully murder for money. Aurienne is a Haelan, a scholar-healer whose Order&rsquo;s motto is <i>Harm to none</i>. Clear-cut absolutes separate them: good and bad, right and wrong, light and dark . . .<br>Until they don&rsquo;t.<br>When Osric first bribed Aurienne to heal him, he never imagined those lines would begin to blur. But every healing session draws them closer together. He finds himself developing unwanted feelings for Aurienne as her capable hands heal his body&mdash;and his heart.<br>Aurienne&rsquo;s perfect life has been flung into chaos in the form of a devastatingly handsome assassin. She should be in her research lab, not illicitly healing a Fyren every full...</dc:description>
